text: OVERDOSAGE Signs of overdose may include confusion, drowsiness, continuing headache, problems with passing urine and rapid weight gain due to fluid retention. ( See WARNINGS .) In case of overdosage, the dosage should be reduced, frequency of administration decreased, or the drug withdrawn according to the severity of the condition. There is no known specific antidote for desmopressin acetate or desmopressin acetate injection 4 mcg/mL. An oral LD 50 has not been established. An intravenous dose of 2 mg/kg in mice demonstrated no effect.
